name: espnow
description: wifi/espnow on two boards, unmodified: each starts Wi-Fi as a station on channel 1 and, after its five seconds, broadcasts ESP-NOW data (vendor-specific action frames) each second; each hears the other's, adds it as a peer with the example's local master key, and the one whose random magic is larger (each chip draws its own numbers) sends it unicast data, encrypted (CCMP under the LMK) and acknowledged, which the other logs. net80211 asks the MAC's random number register for each frame's nonce until it differs from the last. A board starts unicast only after hearing a broadcast that says the other heard its own, so it takes one round more or less depending on which board's broadcast comes first in the second; the boards' drawn EN capacitors and resistors set that (ADR-034), and 10 s covers both orders.
